description: Frozen soak thresholds per validation-and-release.md 47-55. Frozen BEFORE the 10h full run, from the >=30-min warm-up on the same machine/OS/Node. NEVER adjusted by run results; if a gate fails, the run is diagnosed/re-run under a new run id.

soakParams.diHome: isolated temp DI_HOME, artifacts outside repo

thresholdDerivation.rss_max_delta_bytes: warmup observed delta = 3.78MB (baseline 133MB -> max 137MB); frozen at 20MB = ~5x headroom. History is bounded by clear-every-30, so RSS must stay near the warmup plateau; a real leak/accumulation passes well beyond 20MB.
thresholdDerivation.handle_max_delta: warmup observed handle delta = 0; frozen at 8 as a floor (smoke observed transient handles up to 4 during turns).
thresholdDerivation.child_process_max: 1: a transient tool child (~25-40ms live) may land exactly on a sample boundary. Any sample with active_children > 1 is a residue.
thresholdDerivation.child_sustained_max: 0: active_children > 0 across 2 consecutive samples = a child alive >=60s = a leak (all tool children are force-finished within 5s).
thresholdDerivation.resume_p95_max_ms: warmup resume p95 = 2080ms with a 34MB checkpoint. Resume latency is dominated by loadRecovery reading the whole checkpoint, and checkpoint size is ~linear in wall time (clear-window bounded, constant turn rate) -> projected 10h p95 = 2080ms x (600/35) = 35.7s. Frozen at 60s = ~1.7x headroom over the honest projection; worse-than-linear resume degradation fails.
thresholdDerivation.wall_clock_min: 600 = the real 10h wall-clock gate; never derived from iteration counts.

failureCriteria: max RSS - baseline RSS > rss_max_delta_bytes (RSS over limit)
monotonic RSS growth: max RSS over last 2h - max RSS over first 2h > rss_max_delta_bytes (多个采样窗口单调增长)
handle_count not returning to baseline: last - baseline > handle_max_delta (句柄数不回落)
child residue: active_children > child_process_max at any sample, or > child_sustained_max across 2 consecutive samples (子进程残留)
turn failures accumulating > turn_fail_max (失败/恢复错误递增)
resume p95 > resume_p95_max_ms (resume 延迟超限)
documentedDivergences: ContextLimit pause is NOT exercised in the soak: the host runner seam (createCliHost) wires AgentSession without tokenBudget, so contextTokenBudget stays undefined and shouldPauseForContextLimit returns false. ContextLimit semantics are unit-tested in packages/agent (shouldPauseForContextLimit / stopContextLimit) and packages/coding-agent agent-session tests. The soak instead exercises the existing reset/clear interface via periodic runner.resetHistory() per validation-and-release.md 51.

Session checkpoint grows within each clear window because the production writer emits checkpoint_turn_started with the full accumulated history on every turn (agent-session.ts:428) - this is the real C#-mirroring writer behavior. clear-every-30 bounds it to ~linear growth in wall time (~580MB projected at 10h). File growth is expected per validation-and-release.md 51.
